mapper.select: SELECT t.transfer_id, t.user_id, t.session_id, t.from_account_id, t.recipient_id, t.amount, t.status, t.current_step, t.recognized_amount, t.amount_candidates, t.amount_reconfirm_required, t.prepared_at, t.approved_at, t.executed_at, r.display_name AS recipient_display_name, r.bank_code AS recipient_bank_code, r.account_number_enc AS recipient_account_number_enc FROM transfers t JOIN recipients r ON r.owner_user_id = t.user_id AND r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND t.transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT t.transfer_id, t.user_id, t.session_id, t.from_account_id, t.recipient_id, t.amount, t.status, t.current_step, t.recognized_amount, t.amount_candidates, t.amount_reconfirm_required, t.prepared_at, t.approved_at, t.executed_at, r.display_name AS recipient_display_name, r.bank_code AS recipient_bank_code, r.account_number_enc AS recipient_account_number_enc FROM transfers t JOIN recipients r ON r.owner_user_id = t.user_id AND r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND t.transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.transfer_id, t.user_id, t.session_id, t.from_account_id, t.recipient_id, t.amount, t.status, t.current_step, t.recognized_amount, t.amount_candidates, t.amount_reconfirm_required, t.prepared_at, t.approved_at, t.executed_at, r.display_name AS recipient_display_name, r.bank_code AS recipient_bank_code, r.account_number_enc AS recipient_account_number_enc FROM transfers t JOIN recipients r ON r.owner_user_id = t.user_id AND r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND t.session_id = #{sessionId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND t.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY t.prepared_at DESC, t.transfer_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT additional_check_required FROM transfer_risk_assessments WHERE transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY assessed_at DESC, assessment_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id, pin_hash, failed_attempt_count, locked_until FROM user_transfer_pins WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_transfer_pins (user_id, pin_hash, failed_attempt_count, locked_until) VALUES (#{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{pinHash}, 0, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pin_hash = VALUES(pin_hash), failed_attempt_count = 0, locked_until = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user_transfer_pins SET failed_attempt_count = failed_attempt_count + 1, locked_until = CASE WHEN failed_attempt_count + 1 >= 5 THEN #{lockedUntil} ELSE locked_until END WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}
UPDATE user_transfer_pins SET failed_attempt_count = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}
UPDATE transfer_authentications SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'AUTHENTICATED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer_authentications (transfer_authentication_id, transfer_id, user_id, status, expires_at, authenticated_at) VALUES (#{transferAuthenticationId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{authenticatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT transfer_authentication_id, transfer_id, user_id, status, expires_at, consumed_at, authenticated_at FROM transfer_authentications WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY authenticated_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE transfer_authentications SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE transfer_authentication_id = #{transferAuthenticationId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'AUTHENTICATED'
mapper.select: SELECT tr.transaction_id, tr.transfer_id, tr.user_id, tr.from_account_id, tr.recipient_id, tr.amount, tr.status, tr.transferred_at FROM transactions tr WHERE tr.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND tr.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (transaction_id, transfer_id, user_id, from_account_id, recipient_id, amount, status, idempotency_key, transferred_at) VALUES (#{transactionId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{fromAccountId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{recipientId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{transferredAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE transfers SET status = 'EXECUTED', current_step = 'COMPLETED', executed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: SELECT emergency_contact_phone_hash FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT verification_id, transfer_id, target_phone_hash, channel, status, verification_code_hash, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, sent_at, verified_at, failed_at FROM guardian_verifications WHERE transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY created_at DESC, verification_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT verification_id, transfer_id, target_phone_hash, channel, status, verification_code_hash, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, sent_at, verified_at, failed_at FROM guardian_verifications WHERE transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'SENT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT gv.verification_id, gv.transfer_id, gv.target_phone_hash, gv.channel, gv.status, gv.verification_code_hash, gv.attempt_count, gv.max_attempts, gv.expires_at, gv.sent_at, gv.verified_at, gv.failed_at FROM guardian_verifications gv JOIN transfers t ON t.transfer_id = gv.transfer_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND gv.transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND gv.verification_id = #{verificationId, jdbcType=CHAR} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guardian_verifications (verification_id, transfer_id, target_phone_hash, channel, status, verification_code_hash, attempt_count, max_attempts, expires_at, sent_at) VALUES (#{verificationId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{targetPhoneHash}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{verificationCodeHash}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{expiresAt}, #{sentAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE guardian_verifications SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'SENT'
UPDATE guardian_verifications SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'SENT'
UPDATE guardian_verifications SET status = 'FAILED', failed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'SENT'
UPDATE guardian_verifications SET status = 'VERIFIED', verified_at = #{verifiedAt} WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'SENT'
UPDATE transfers SET status = 'RECONFIRM', current_step = 'CONFIRM' WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND transfer_id = #{transferId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'HELD'
